title: JANUS retrocausality candidate methods: eight-bit signalling vs postselection, noisy Bell branches, quantum switch and independent history calibration
study_question: Can an earlier receiver decode a future independent single byte (8 bits) without any information from postselection or later classical signals?

source_review.name: Retrocausal Capacity of a Quantum Channel: Communicating through Noisy Closed Timelike Curves
source_review.finding: One-shot and asymptotic retrocausal capacities in hypothetical noisy postselected CTC quantum channels; no laboratory backward-time channel demonstrated.

source_review.name: Experimental simulation of postselected closed timelike curves for decoding scrambled quantum information
source_review.finding: Quantinuum and IBM experiments show conditional decoding with final postselected outcome; authors explicitly deny actual physical time travel.

source_review.name: Time Symmetry in the Quantum Process of Measurement
source_review.finding: Time-symmetric ensemble probabilities require knowing later final-state selection; early unconditional observer cannot decode a freely chosen later byte.

source_review.name: Experimental delayed-choice entanglement swapping
source_review.finding: Later quantum-random choice influences how earlier photon correlations are partitioned, but early unconditioned records do not carry an operator-readable later message.

source_review.name: Experimental superposition of a quantum evolution with its time reverse
source_review.finding: Superposition of evolution and inverse process, distinct from classical message travelling to laboratory past.

source_review.name: Generalized Indefinite Causal Orders in an Integrated Quantum Switch
source_review.finding: Certifies indefinite order of quantum operations, not a receiver reading bytes before sender choice.

source_review.name: Experimental quantum key distribution in an indefinite causal order
source_review.finding: Cryptographic proof-of-principle, yet presently postselection-dependent and not a backward classical communication channel.

source_review.name: Operational formulation of time reversal in quantum theory
source_review.finding: Shows formal symmetry of quantum operations involving pre/postselection; does not supply physical early byte to receive later freely chosen message.

source_review.name: Quantum simulation of traversable-wormhole-inspired quantum teleportation in a chaotic binary sparse SYK model
source_review.finding: Models traversable-wormhole-inspired teleportation with entangled many-body dynamics on quantum processor; not a literal wormhole or past-signalling endpoint.

source_artifacts.random_method: Independent deterministic pseudorandom streams for reproducible nonphysical Monte-Carlo; does not constitute an unpredictable real late choice.

simulated_byte_test.operational_unconditional_channel_inform: 0 in the exact mathematical model; finite random sample agreement is near chance
simulated_byte_test.why_selected_not_operational: A receiver cannot know at t0 which runs survive the t2/t3 late test. Conditioning retrospectively uses the future outcome as a classical selection key.
simulated_byte_test.special_zero_noise_results_note: 249 selected of 65536, all 249 matching; all 65536 raw trials are retained in unconditional evaluation.

intentionally_leaked_future_byte.reason: Injected earlier=late target violates required timestamp isolation; this is only a regression test of leakage detection.

fail_closed_causes: No authenticated physical device or spacetime retrocausal channel exists in JANUS.
All candidate correlations requiring late postselection are disallowed as an early received signal.
Standard quantum switch coherence is not an independent late message into the physical past.
No early snapshot independently reveals a late cryptographically random 8-bit message.
method_selection.physically_realizable_next_experiment: With authorized QPU or optical lab, run preregistered independent future-byte selection and lock all unfiltered early detector records. Blindly compare early bytes to future choices before any late selection, with isolation, hardware timing, detector leakage tests and independent replication.
method_selection.promotion_barrier: No autonomous self-teaching using hypothetical backward information unless operational early decoding has been independently replicated; historical future labels may still teach JANUS by ordinary forward-time delayed feedback.
